ja: この機能は来週出しましょう。
en: Let's release this next week.
alternatives: Let's ship this next week.
Let's launch it next week.
point: 提案は Let's + 動詞の原形

ja: お客さんから要望が来てます。
en: We have a customer request.
alternatives: A customer sent us a request.
We got a customer request.
point: request は数えられる名詞なので a を付ける

ja: 営業に、要望をまとめるよう頼んでくれる？
en: Can you ask sales to compile the requests?
alternatives: Could you ask sales to consolidate their requests?
Could you have sales put their requests together?
point: ask + 人 + to do の語順。that 節にしない

ja: セキュリティ審査が済んで初めて、リリース日を決められます。
en: Only after the security review can we set a release date.
alternatives: We can't set a release date until security review is done.
Only once security review is done can we set a date.
point: Only after 節が文頭だと can we の語順になる

ja: このアプリ、オフラインで使えたらいいのに。
en: I wish this app worked offline.
alternatives: If only this app worked offline.
I wish I could use this app offline.
point: 現在の願望は wish の後を過去形にする

ja: このバグが最優先です。
en: This bug is top priority.
alternatives: This bug is our top priority.
This bug comes first.
point: 「最優先」は top priority で表せる

ja: 先週ついにダークモードを追加しました。
en: We finally added dark mode last week.
alternatives: Last week, we finally added dark mode.
We finally launched dark mode last week.
point: last week があるので現在完了ではなく過去形

ja: まず、ログインのバグを直すべきです。
en: We should fix the login bug first.
alternatives: First, we should fix the login bug.
The login bug should be fixed first.
point: should の後は動詞の原形。主語は we を補う

ja: 今、うちで検索を改善しているところ。
en: We're improving search right now.
alternatives: We're making search better right now.
Our team is improving search now.
point: 「今〜しているところ」は be + -ing にする

ja: うちはもっとテストを書かないと。
en: We have to write more tests.
alternatives: We need to write more tests.
We've got to write more tests.
point: 「〜しないと」は have to。we を主語に立てる

ja: 来週出荷するしかないとしたら、あなたなら何を削る？
en: If you had to ship next week, what would you cut?
alternatives: What would you cut if you had to ship next week?
If you were forced to ship next week, what would you drop?
point: 現実味の薄い仮定は if + 過去形、主節は would。cut は「削る」

ja: A案は速いのに対し、B案は安全です。
en: Plan A is fast, whereas B is safe.
alternatives: Plan A is fast, but B is safe.
While A is fast, B is safe.
point: 対比は whereas / while で二つの文をつなぐ

ja: ベータが終わったら、出すか決めよう。
en: Let's decide whether to launch after beta.
alternatives: After beta ends, let's decide whether to launch.
Let's decide whether to release once beta ends.
point: 「〜するかどうか」は whether to + 動詞の原形

ja: その機能、もうロールアウトされた？
en: Has that feature been rolled out yet?
alternatives: Has that feature shipped yet?
Is that feature live yet?
point: 「もう」の疑問は現在完了 + yet

ja: 営業は、解約を理由にその機能を押しています。
en: Sales is pushing that feature, citing possible cancellations.
alternatives: Sales is pushing for that feature because customers might cancel.
The sales team is pushing that feature, citing churn risk.
point: 「〜を理由に」は文末に citing 〜 と分詞で添える

ja: お客さんには、どっちの機能が大事？
en: Which feature matters more to customers?
alternatives: Which feature is more important to customers?
Which feature do customers care about more?
point: 2つを比べるので most ではなく more を使う

ja: うちはリリースを延期すべきだったよ。
en: We should have postponed the release.
alternatives: We should have pushed the release back.
We ought to have delayed the release.
point: 「〜すべきだった」は should have + 過去分詞

ja: サラ、それ次のスプリントに回してくれる？
en: Sara, could you push that to next sprint?
alternatives: Sara, could you bump that to next sprint?
Sara, can you hold that till next sprint?
point: 「後回しにする」は push / bump で言える

ja: PMはその要望を見落としたのかもしれない。
en: The PM might have missed that request.
alternatives: The PM may have overlooked that request.
Maybe the PM overlooked that request.
point: 過去の推量は might have + 過去分詞

ja: これ、もう3週間レビュー中です。
en: It's been in review for three weeks.
alternatives: It's been under review for three weeks.
It's been stuck in review for three weeks.
point: 継続中の状態は has been で表す（is では不可）

ja: SSOを求めるのは、無料ユーザーでなく法人客だ。
en: It's enterprise customers, not free users, who want SSO.
alternatives: It's enterprise customers rather than free users who want SSO.
It's enterprise customers who want SSO, not free users.
point: It's A, not B, who 〜 の強調構文で「A こそが」を表す

ja: 知りたいのは、それがいつリリースされるかです。
en: What I'd like to know is when it'll ship.
alternatives: I'd like to know when it's going to ship.
What I'm asking is when it will be released.
point: What ～ is の強調文のあとは when it will ～ の語順

ja: 今朝報告のバグで、リリースが遅れるかもしれません。
en: The bug reported this morning could push back the release.
alternatives: The bug reported this morning might delay the release.
The bug flagged this morning may push the release back.
point: 「報告された」は reported で名詞を後ろから修飾。could で控えめに

ja: ベータを出したら、フィードバック集めに集中しよう。
en: Once the beta's out, let's focus on gathering feedback.
alternatives: When we ship the beta, let's focus on gathering feedback.
After we release the beta, let's concentrate on collecting feedback.
point: focus on の後は動名詞。once 節は未来でも現在形

ja: エクスポート機能の要望が多い。
en: There are many export requests.
alternatives: Many users want an export feature.
We have many export requests.
point: requests は複数なので There are で始める

ja: 来週出す機能に、バグがあるよ。
en: The feature shipping next week has a bug.
alternatives: The feature launching next week has a bug.
There's a bug in next week's feature.
point: 名詞の後ろに shipping などの -ing で説明を足す

ja: テストは通りましたが、まだ出せません。
en: Although the tests passed, we can't ship yet.
alternatives: The tests passed, but we can't ship yet.
Even though the tests passed, we can't ship.
point: Although の節のあとにカンマ、but とは併用しない

ja: 機能は削ったが、新UIは好評です。
en: Although we cut features, the new UI is popular.
alternatives: We cut features, but the new UI is popular.
Even though we cut features, the new UI is popular.
point: Although の節には but を重ねない

ja: 決済は来月にずれ込むかもとPMが言ってた。
en: The PM said payments might slip to next month.
alternatives: The PM said payments could slip to next month.
Our PM said payments might slip into next month.
point: said に合わせて may ではなく might にする

ja: エンジニアがいつ修正を出せるか、調べてもらえる？
en: Can you find out when engineering can ship the fix?
alternatives: Could you check when the engineers can ship the fix?
Can you ask engineering when they can ship it?
point: 間接疑問は when のあと平叙文の語順（can ship）

ja: ユーザーは写真を共有できない。
en: Users can't share photos.
alternatives: Users are unable to share photos.
Users aren't able to share photos.
point: 「できない」は can't＋動詞の原形

ja: ユーザーは何年も前からその機能を切望しています。
en: Users have been begging for that feature for years.
alternatives: Users have been clamoring for that feature for years.
For years, users have been pleading for that feature.
point: 「ずっと〜している」は現在完了進行形。for years と相性がよい

ja: ユーザーはこの機能をずっと待っています。
en: Users have been waiting for this feature.
alternatives: Users have been waiting on this feature.
People have been waiting for this feature.
point: 「ずっと〜している」は have been -ing、待つは wait for

ja: 客が一番求める機能は、今回入りません。
en: The feature customers want most isn't included.
alternatives: The feature customers want most won't make it.
Our customers' most wanted feature isn't included.
point: 目的語の that は省ける。want の後に it を足さない

ja: その機能は三か月も棚上げされています。
en: That feature has been shelved for three months.
alternatives: That feature has been on hold for three months.
We've had that feature on hold for three months.
point: 期間を表す for と現在完了の受け身
